content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to connect my buhler scales using Profibus DP with a [company_name] [product_name] controller. Can you advise which Profibus DP module should be used with [product_name], and how to set up and program the interface? Any assistance would be appreciated.
[company_name] does not offer a gateway module for the [product_name] that enables Profibus connectivity.
Are there alternative PLC project examples for connecting a buhler scale via Profibus?

[product_name] models with [article_no] from the initial generation only support Ethernet TCP/IP using S7 protocol. Starting from [product_name] version 8.1, Modbus TCP/IP is also available. Other fieldbus protocols such as Profibus, Profinet IO, or CAN are not supported by [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: The original poster is looking to integrate buhler scales with a [company_name] [product_name] controller by utilizing Profibus DP. The discussion highlights that [product_name] controllers do not support Profibus DP modules, thereby limiting compatibility with devices that rely on this protocol. Replies clarify which communication protocols are available for different [product_name] versions and emphasize the absence of Profibus support, pointing to a notable feature gap.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is hoping to find an official Profibus DP expansion or gateway module suitable for use with the [company_name] [product_name] controller, as well as guidance on connecting and programming this type of integration.
